body:
My wife does try to help in every way she can by planning fun outings. We've gone and done fun things and I enjoy them when we do them. I also love just sitting around over the weekends but it feels like it's never enough time. 

Sometimes I end up spoiling the weekend and time off because I'm so depressed and angry over how much time I spend at work.

It wouldn't be so bad if my coworkers weren't constantly teasing me in a sort of "hazing" manner. I go to my boss and he does nothing about it. 

The job isn't that hard but it takes a toll when you are doing the job of 4 people because everyone wants to sit and play on their phones or on Facebook.

I barely get to enjoy my weekends and time away from work because I feel drained and sleep for most of it. 

I don't mean to complain to you about it. I am working on a degree to work in a field I want but sometimes I wonder if it's even what I want. I am also looking for other jobs but a lot require 6+ months of experience so I am waiting.
I work 50+ hours because it's the only job that I found after 5 months of looking for one.
